sections.title: Dispatches from #tech-channel
sections.commentary: Heated debate and banter erupts in #tech-channel over game tape, timing, and locker room etiquette.

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: I don't think they have that yet

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: Mikey from Ice Pilots is heading it

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: This is cool stuff.  I have heard a little about the goings on over the past few weeks….i am sure they will get it to work.  I am curious about the cost and if there would be fees to join (I would think there would be)

messages.author: UltraMagnus
messages.text: the big thing is will it be user freidnly and stop having to update our things manually allow the updates for everyone to be seamless with retroarch

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Do u mean update the rosters?  If so I don’t know but that sounds difficult.  There would only be 1 rom though which is the one available when u join to play that’s hosted, so nobody would need to download roms and stuff.

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: If we can get away from Retro Arch and port forwarding I can get move luddites in the league

messages.author: UltraMagnus
messages.text: Basically it will be just the connection. Its more how does the data from the save states match up with retroarch

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Backend process that runs after each game.  I don’t pretend to know how they are setting this up but my hunch would be getting the data to the db would be one of the easier parts.  Easy for me to say

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Anything can call an api so they would likely just do pretty much what they are doing now, it would just be done from a different place

messages.author: UltraMagnus
messages.text: Will just depend on the structure of the saves

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
I will go on record now and state that unless whatever they have they would share and it would work out of the box (or at least require very minimal tweaks), it wouldn’t be worth it for this collection of nhl95 players.  These dudes don’t even play really….there’s my 2 cents - sorry @segathon 

It would have the potential to bring in new players though…..
